lines: CASTLE MUSEUM, GROUND FLOOR. HISTORY and the CENTRAL HALL off the ENTRANCE HALL, the CONVENIENCES through HISTORY. The CLOAKROOM, ARTS and SCIENCE off the CENTRAL HALL; MAINTENANCE through the CLOAKROOM, and the STORES through SCIENCE.
Open ten to four. A fourth wing off the CENTRAL HALL has been PAINTED OVER on the plan, in council cream. It went on thick, and it ran before it dried.
The doorways off this hall, the CENTRAL HALL and SCIENCE each have a board beside them with the name on.
VISITORS ARE ASKED NOT TO TOUCH THE EXHIBITS.
The exhibits have been asked the same. Please report any that forget. Signed, the Attendant.
MAINTENANCE. The gallery lighting and the power shutters are on this breaker.
It is not to be thrown during opening hours. It has been, twice, and the dents in the shutters are still there. Signed, the Attendant.
THE MODERN METHOD. Presented by the Company. The figure holds a charge in its right hand, and the hand's closed tight on it.
Folded into the glove, one page in her handwriting: "Shot-firing. Set it. Count to five. Be behind something by three. Keep it dry."
No J. at the foot this time. The letters are bigger than in my letter, and they slope downhill.
The glove's open and empty now. The Company's label is still screwed to the plinth.
CLOAKROOM. The stove's lit, and the hooks are numbered up to sixty. Fourteen still have coats on them, buttoned, with the tickets in the pockets.
Nothing comes in here. If it goes badly out there, this is where I'll wake.
A portrait in oils, three quarters, a man in a good coat. The brass label reads GNOX GOLDSKIN, BENEFACTOR.
The face has been scratched out from the front with something blunt, round and round, until the canvas shows through.
Under the label, a second plate, smaller: PRESENTED BY THE GRATEFUL STAFF OF THE COMPANY, ON THE OPENING OF THE COMPANY SCHOOL.
ENTRANCE HALL. The way out, and the floor plan. Visitors are asked to leave by the way they came in.
CENTRAL HALL. The CLOAKROOM, ARTS and SCIENCE are off this hall. Visitors are asked to keep moving.
HISTORY. THE COUNTY AND THE COMPANY.
Under it, on a card in the Attendant's hand: the CONVENIENCES are through this gallery. Please do not linger.
CLOAKROOM. Coats to be collected by four. MAINTENANCE through the cloakroom, staff only.
ARTS. The exhibits are not to leave their plinths while the lights are on. Signed, the Attendant.
SCIENCE. THE MODERN METHOD. PRESENTED BY THE COMPANY FOR THE BETTERMENT OF THE COUNTY.
Under it, on a card in the Attendant's hand: FLOOR KEY No. 3 is kept in ARTS.
STORES. Power shutter. Staff only. The shutter does not rise without the gallery lights.
The board's been painted over in council cream, the same as the wing on the plan. The letters show through it anyway: MAGIC.
Behind it the arch is new plaster, still grey at the edges, and there's a draught coming through it, cold on my wrists.
